messages:
jamie: Heads up — CI is red on my PR (branch fix/kvcache-typing). It failed the type/lint gating job. mypy + rustfmt both failing. Dumping first errors:

jamie: mypy:
```
src/inference/kvcache.py:123: error: Incompatible return value type (got "Optional[Dict[str, Any]]", expected "Dict[str, Any]")
```

jamie: rustfmt failure in crates/serving/src/lib.rs: formatting changed.

neha: is this from your last change to Optional[...] vs {} default? quick glance shows kvcache init return None in one path.

ryan: can you paste the failing CI job link? I'll kick a rerun if flaky.

jamie: https://ci.redwood.internal/teams/eng/builds/5823 — rerun didn't help, same failure.

taylor: might be mypy strictness bump in toolchain.yml — we recently bumped --strict-optional. check pyproject.toml? run `tox -e typecheck` locally.

maya: pinging @ci-bot for bisect help

ci-bot: @channel Triggered rerun for build 5823 — queued on dedicated runners. Use `/ci bisect 5823 --down-to 5720` to run a commit-range bisect (requires maintainer tag).

neha: Jamie — can you run `git bisect start -- bad old_commit && git bisect run ./scripts/typecheck_check.sh` or I can take it if you prefer.

jamie: I'll start bisect now. Leaving notes: locally `mypy src --no-incremental` reproduces the error. I'll report progress.

ryan: Also FYI rustfmt error sometimes from rustfmt version mismatch — CI uses nightly-2025-01-01. run `rustup show` and `rustfmt --version`.

taylor: If bisect shows a toolchain bump, we should add a matrix to CI to pin the toolchain until we fix.

jamie: First bisect step: narrowed to commit 8f3a2a9 -> 8f3a2f0 where tests started failing. That patch touched typing in kvcache.

neha: probable cause — convert Optional[...] to Dict[...] in signature without updating callers. Quick fix: change return annotation to Optional[Dict[str, Any]] and add explicit {} return.

maya: small note: pre-commit hook also flagged EOL on windows line endings in test files, could be unrelated but blocks local runs. `git config core.autocrlf false` helps.

jamie: thanks — opened PR to fix typing + add a small test; will push and trigger CI. Assigning reviewers @neha @ryan.

ci-bot: build 5827 started for jamie/fix-kvcache-typing — typecheck job queued.

neha: will review once CI passes. if flaky still, lemme know and I'll finish bisect.

jamie: thanks folks. keeping thread open until CI green. :thumbsup:
